value.rationale: A homogeneous directed cycle is the simplest irreducible nonsymmetric conservative transport generator. Its sharp complete fourth-order Gauss endpoint positivity regime changes at dimensions 4 and 8. The four natural complete exact Hn are unknown/not implied by the inspected general small-h results and identify a genuinely useful timestep safety boundary for this numerical test family without requiring a broader general theorem.
